sources.excerpt: Boss HM-3 HYPER Metal Guitar Pedal Schematic Diagram Electronics > Schematic diagrams > Guitar effects > Boss HM-3 HYPER Metal schematic Boss HM-3 HYPER Metal pedal schematic diagram The BOSS HM-3 guitar pedal's internal circuitry is designed for greater gain and accurate dynamic response to produce a powerful, hard edged sound with awesome sustain - just like you'd expect from fully overdriven stacked tube amps. Using independent controls for high and low frequencies, you can create just about any tone from mild and crunchy to heavy and metallic. It was sold from April 1993 to December 1998. Fig. 1: Boss HM-3 HYPER Metal guitar pedal schematic diagram Fig. 2: Boss HM-3 circuit board (component side) Specifications: 4 Controls : Level, Color Mix Low, Color Mix High, Dist Connectors : Input, Output, AC Adaptor Equivalent input noise : -120dBm (IHF-A, Typ.) Input impedance : 1MΩ Output impedance : 1kΩ Recommended load impedance : 10kΩ or greater AC adaptor : PSA series Current draw : 12mA (DC 9V) Weight : 420g / 15 oz (including battery) ICs, transistors and diodes used in the HM-3: IC1, IC2: M5218AL (dual low-noise opamp) Q1: 2SK184GR or 2SK117GR (FET) Q2, Q3, Q4: 2SK118Y (FET) Q5, Q9, Q10, Q11, Q12: 2SC3378GR or 2SC2240GR Q6, Q7, Q8: 2SC2458GR D1-D8: 1SS133 (high speed switching diode) D9: S5688G (general purpose rectifier diode) D10: RD5.6EB3 (5.6V Zener) LED1: LN-28RP (red LED) Fig. 3: Boss HM-3 HYPER Metal PCB (foil & component side) Arion SCH-1 Chorus Boss CE-2 Chorus CE-2B Bass Chorus Boss CE-3 Chorus Boss CE-5 Chorus Boss CE-5A Chorus DOD FX60 Chorus DOD FX65 Chorus Pearl CH-02 Chorus Boss BF-2 Flanger Boss HF-2 Hi Band Flanger Pearl FG-01 Flanger Boss BD-2 Blues Driver Boss CS-2 Compr.
